mapper.select: select distinct #{YES_NO_N,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as innovation, pdi.prd_design_id as planningSeriesNo, pdi.prd_design_serial_name as planningSeriesName, TEMP1.initialPlanningValue AS initialPlanningValue, TEMP.RenewahShare/10000 as productsDue from PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO pdi left join (select sum(bpp.tdy_share_amt/10000 ) as initialPlanningValue,fpa.prd_design_id prd_design_id from BOK_POSITION_PRD bpp left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa on fpa.finprod_id=bpp.finprod_id and bpp.branch=0 AND DATE_FORMAT(bpp.CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{baseDate} group by fpa.prd_design_id) TEMP1 on TEMP1.prd_design_id = pdi.prd_design_id left join (select sum(CASE WHEN dfpdt.ps in (#{PS_QZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPRG,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPSG,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPHLTZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) then dfpdt.share_amt else (-1*dfpdt.share_amt) end ) RenewahShare,fpa1.prd_design_id prd_design_id from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL dfpdt left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa1 on dfpdt.finprod_id = fpa1.finprod_id where dfpdt.is_cancel= #{YES_NO_N,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dfpdt.trade_status= #{JYZT,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dfpdt.busi_type in (#{SYS_YQSYX,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{SYS_JZX,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{SYS_HBX,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND dfpdt.TRADE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{planningStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and dfpdt.ps in (#{PS_QZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPRG,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPSG,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPSH,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPTQSH,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPDQ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_TQZZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_FEQJ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPWYSH,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPHLTZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) group by fpa1.prd_design_id) TEMP on TEMP.prd_design_id = pdi.prd_design_id

AND (B.prd_plan_seris_id IN
null) or B.prd_plan_seris_id IN (

select sum(CASE WHEN dfpdt.ps in (#{PS_QZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPRG,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPSG,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPHLTZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) then dfpdt.share_amt else (-1*dfpdt.share_amt) end ) productsDue from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL dfpdt left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa1 on dfpdt.finprod_id = fpa1.finprod_id where dfpdt.is_cancel= #{YES_NO_N,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dfpdt.trade_status= #{JYZT,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prd_design_id =#{planningSeriesNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dfpdt.busi_type in (#{SYS_YQSYX,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{SYS_JZX,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{SYS_HBX,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND dfpdt.TRADE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{planningStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and dfpdt.ps in (#{PS_QZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPRG,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPSG,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPSH,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPTQSH,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPDQ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_TQZZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_FEQJ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPWYSH,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPHLTZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRD_PLAN_DETAIL (PRD_PLAN_CODE, PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID, PRD_PLAN_SERIS_NAME, PLAN_INIT_AMT, PLAN_CHANGE_AMT, PLAN_TARGET_AMT, IS_NEW, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES( #{planningNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{planningSeriesNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{planningSeriesName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{initialPlanningValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{planningChangeValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{planningTargetValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{innovation,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STR_TO_DATE(NOW()), #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STR_TO_DATE(NOW()) )
